changelog.body:
- New Addons tab (replaces Tools): browse, search addons right in the app, and turn each owned addon on or off
- The virtual SIM now follows your proxy country: switching to a proxy in another country regenerates the SIM to match
- Fixed the real country leaking on devices without a SIM card
- The virtual SIM now reports a "ready" state like a real SIM

- Sensor spoofing now also covers apps that read sensors through native code (NDK)
- Native and Java sensor readings now return identical values, so apps can no longer tell them apart
- Fixed proximity sensor values not being spoofed in some apps
- Fixed a rare mismatch in light sensor values between different readers

- Added French language support
- Fixed text overflow and layout issues in several languages
- Long update notes now scroll so the install button always stays reachable
- Improved the update card, app filters and Premium comparison table layout
- More screens are now fully translated
- Fix some crash issues on Android 16

- Realistic sensors, fully upgraded: all motion sensors now come from one simulated phone held in a hand. The accelerometer, gyroscope, gravity, linear acceleration, rotation vector and orientation all describe the same movement, so apps that check one sensor against another get consistent results.
- New: magnetometer (compass) spoofing. The magnetic field matches your profile's spoofed location, and the compass direction agrees with the other motion sensors.
- New: barometer (pressure) spoofing. Air pressure matches the altitude your spoofed GPS location reports, with small natural weather changes.
- Smarter light sensor: light levels now follow the time of day in your profile's timezone (night, twilight, day). They also dim when the proximity sensor is covered, like a phone held to your ear.
- New: sensor list matches the simulated device. When Device Simulation is on, the sensor names, vendors and specs that apps can read match the phone model you picked. Sensors that model wouldn't have are hidden.
- Each profile now keeps its own stable sensor calibration values, so a profile looks like the same physical phone across app restarts and across all its target apps.
- Improved install-time protection: the app install date that apps read from files on disk now matches your profile's spoofed install date.
- Improved root & hook hiding: covered more debugger and hook checks, hid more traces of systemless root modifications, and hid the "OEM unlocking" developer flag.
- New toggles for each new sensor are in the profile's Privacy Settings. They are on by default for existing profiles.
- Various stability improvements and minor bug fixes.

- Improved VPN hiding: some apps could still detect an active VPN through an older Android network API — that gap is now closed.
- Strengthened protection of your identity
- Various stability improvements and minor bug fixes.

- Fixed a Google Advertising ID (GAID) leak — some apps could still read your real advertising ID by asking the ad service directly over its binder interface, bypassing the spoof. That path is now covered, so your profile's advertising ID stays consistent everywhere.
- Improved stability on Android 16

- Improved device identity protection: closed a few more ways apps could read your real device ID and system settings, so spoofed profiles stay consistent.
- Improved root hiding: better filtering of root and system traces from apps that inspect system command output.
- Fixed a sign-in issue where an expired session could get stuck instead of automatically refreshing or signing you out.
- Fixed several important bugs and general stability improvements.

- Added realistic light (ambient) sensor spoofing — the reported light level now follows a natural, continuously changing pattern that you can match to a setting (indoor, on the move, outdoors, or night), so apps see believable sensor data instead of a static or missing value.
- Fix some mirror bugs

- Added realistic gyroscope motion spoofing, synchronized with the accelerometer so both sensors report consistent, believable movement — including the raw (uncalibrated) values some apps cross-check.
- Delete profile now asks for confirmation before removing anything, and Delete has been moved away from "Set as active" in the profile menu to prevent accidental deletion.

- Hide the module's own footprint from apps that scan the process memory maps, so it is no longer visible to them.
- Hide root and root-manager traces from apps that read the process mount list, making a spoofed device less likely to be flagged as rooted or hooked.
- Fixed a few minor issues from the previous version

- Added spoofing of extra advertising identifiers (OAID) to reduce tracking on supported devices
- Stability and compatibility improvements
- Fix crashes on some devices

- Fix some payment issues
- Make the app's installation source more trustworthy

- Improve the system
- Improve the user interface
- Fix some minor bugs
- Fix license loss issues

- Fixed several issues from the previous version.
- Updates are no longer mandatory by default.
- Mandatory updates will only be required for certain critical versions.

- Added a headless backup and restore API to automate profile backups without opening the app
- Improved device simulation to better match real devices
- Improved hiding of root access from detection
- Fixed profile backup folders not being fully removed when deleted

- Fix app crashes on certain devices
- Improve the hidden Developer Options feature
- Improve the user interface (UI)

- Added Google Play Billing support
- Fixed license issues on some devices
- Improved UI/UX
- Fixed some issues from the previous version
- Fixed several issues related to application crashes
- Fixed some issues from the previous version

- Custom device simulation templates (Premium): import/export templates as JSON with a downloadable sample file to edit.
- Fixed the scroll-to-bottom button so it's tappable and clearly visible.

- Fix crash when opening Maps.
- Fix white screen after exiting the Support screen.

- set a custom location (gps, region, timezone) per profile without needing a proxy, with a map picker for coordinates
- location settings gathered into one card with searchable region and timezone pickers
- more accurate locale spoofing: 176 countries mapped instead of 43
- fix: turning a proxy off now also stops its location spoof
- restore no longer wipes existing profiles, it merges by default
- headless api: read/write the custom location and duplicate a profile
- Fixed a crash when using Headless Mode features

- Added AI Chatbot support
- Improved WebView functionality
- Enhanced Device Simulation
- Added new Device Mock Templates
- Improved the overall UI/UX

- Improved the identifier spoofing feature.
- Fixed an issue where the IP address didn't change when switching profiles.
- Fixed crashes affecting some devices.
- Improved UI/UX for a smoother experience.

readme: # HideMyAndroid ![HideMyAndroid Thumbnail](images/thumbnail.png) [![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-2D333B?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.wowsoftware.hidemyandroid/releases/latest) [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/Latest%20Release-2F81F7?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.wowsoftware.hidemyandroid/releases/latest) ## English [English](#english) | [简体中文](#zh-cn) | [Русская версия](#ru) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#id) ### Support/Discussion Support: https://t.me/hidemyandroid HideMyAndroid is a privacy-focused Android module built to reduce app tracking and device fingerprinting through profile-based masking/spoofing. Official Website: https://www.hidemyandroid.com Web App / Dashboard: https://app.hidemyandroid.com How to install: https://www.hidemyandroid.com/en/how-to-install/ ### Requirements - Android 9.0+ (Pie or newer) - Rooted Android device - Properly working Xposed/LSPosed environment - If you are not familiar with Xposed modules, this project may not be suitable for your setup. ### How It Works When a target app requests identifiers or environment signals, HideMyAndroid intercepts the request and returns configured spoofed values based on your selected profile. ### Feature List - Spoof Device Identifiers (Android ID, GAID, GSF ID, Widevine DRM ID, App Set ID, IMEI, Serial, ...) - Spoof SIM Card Info - Spoof Mobile Number - Hide Root - Hide LSPosed - Hide VPN Connection - Hide Active Proxy Connection from Apps - Browser Fingerprint - Hide Airplane Mode - Hide Wi-Fi Information (NAME/MAC) - Spoof Nearby Wi-Fi Networks - Spoof Nearby Bluetooth Devices - Block LAN Scan - Hide Developer Mode - Headless Mode (Developer Mode) - Spoof Play Store Installation - Spoof Timezone Based on IP - Spoof Region Based on IP - Spoof GPS Location Based on IP - Spoof App Identity - Isolated Account Environment - Virtual Gmail Accounts Per Profile - Hide Installed Applications - Realistic Sensor Data: accelerometer, gyroscope, compass and motion fusion sensors all come from one simulated motion model, while the compass, barometer and light sensor follow the profile's location, altitude and local time, so cross-checks between sensors stay consistent. - Magnetometer: simulate a compass field matching the profile location and device orientation. - Motion fusion sensors: keep gravity, linear acceleration, rotation vector and orientation consistent with the simulated motion. - Barometer: report air pressure that matches the spoofed location's altitude, with slow weather drift. - Sensor list: make the sensor list and each sensor's name, vendor, range and resolution match the simulated device. - Spoof Device Uptime - Device Simulation - Profile-Based System - Backup & Restore app's data - Per-Profile Proxy (each profile can use its own independent proxy configuration) - Hide Suspicious Keyboards - Virtual Default Keyboard Value - Many More Features ### Free vs Premium | Features | Freemium | Premium (Subscription) | | ------------------------------------------------- | :------: | :--------------------: | | Hide device identifiers (partial/full by plan) | ✅ | ✅ | | Backup & restore app data | ✅ | ✅ | | Hide active VPN from apps | ✅ | ✅ | | Spoof Wi-Fi SSID/BSSID | ✅ | ✅ | | Hide Developer Options state | ✅ | ✅ | | Spoof installer as Google Play | ✅ | ✅ | | Hide installed apps list | ✅ | ✅ | | Hide suspicious keyboards from enabled keyboard lists | ✅ | ✅ | | Virtual default keyboard value spoofing | ✅ | ✅ | | Device Simulation | ✅ | ✅ | | Hide active proxy connection from apps | | ✅ | | Hide Root | | ✅ | | Hide LSPosed | | ✅ | | Browser Fingerprint | | ✅ | | Spoof SIM card info | | ✅ | | Spoof mobile number | | ✅ | | Hide airplane mode state from apps | | ✅ | | Spoof nearby Wi-Fi networks | | ✅ | | Spoof nearby Bluetooth devices | | ✅ | | Block private LAN scan behavior | | ✅ | | Spoof timezone by geo | | ✅ | | Spoof locale/region by geo | | ✅ | | Spoof GPS by geo | | ✅ | | Spoof app identity | | ✅ | | Virtual Gmail accounts per profile | | ✅ | | Virtual account isolation per profile | | ✅ | | Simulate accelerometer sensor data | | ✅ | | Simulate gyroscope sensor data | | ✅ | | Simulate light sensor data | | ✅ | | Simulate magnetometer (compass) data | | ✅ | | Simulate motion fusion sensors (gravity, rotation vector, orientation) | | ✅ | | Simulate barometer (air pressure) data | | ✅ | | Match sensor list to the simulated device | | ✅ | | Spoof device uptime | | ✅ | | Headless Mode (Developer Mode) | | ✅ | ### Important Notice System-level modification always carries risk. Please back up your ROM and important data before use. ### Disclaimer Use at your own risk. By installing or using HideMyAndroid, you are solely responsible for how you use it. The developers are not responsible for misuse, violations of laws/platform policies, account penalties, data loss, instability, or bootloops. ### Ongoing Updates HideMyAndroid is actively maintained with continuous feature and stability updates. ### Feature Requests Feature requests are welcome. If you need a specific capability, share your use case and we will prioritize based on community demand. --- ## 简体中文 [English](#english) | [简体中文](#zh-cn) | [Русская версия](#ru) | [Bahasa Indonesia](#id) ### 支持与讨论 Support: https://t.me/hidemyandroid HideMyAndroid 是一款以隐私保护为核心的 Android 模块。它通过基于配置文件的隐藏与伪装机制，降低应用跟踪和设备指纹识别风险。 官方网站: https://www.hidemyandroid.com Web 应用 / 控制台: https://app.hidemyandroid.com 安装教程: https://www.hidemyandroid.com/zh/how-to-install/ ### 使用要求 - Android 9.0+（Pie 或更高版本） - 已 Root 的 Android 设备 - 可正常运行的 Xposed/LSPosed 环境 - 如果你不熟悉 Xposed 模块，本项目可能不适合你的设备环境。 ### 工作机制 当目标应用请求设备标识符或环境信号时，HideMyAndroid 会拦截请求，并根据你选择的配置文件返回已设置的伪装值。 ### 功能一览 - 伪装设备标识符（Android ID、GAID、GSF ID、Widevine DRM ID、App Set ID、IMEI、Serial 等） - 伪装 SIM 卡信息 - 伪装手机号 - 隐藏 Root - 隐藏 LSPosed - 隐藏 VPN 连接状态 - 对应用隐藏当前代理连接状态 - 浏览器指纹 - 隐藏飞行模式状态 - 隐藏 Wi-Fi 信息（名称/MAC） - 伪造附近 Wi-Fi 网络 - 伪造附近蓝牙设备 - 阻止局域网扫描 - 隐藏开发者模式状态 - 无头模式（开发者模式） - 伪装为通过 Play 商店安装 - 基于 IP 伪装时区 - 基于 IP 伪装地区 - 基于 IP 伪装 GPS 位置 - 伪装应用身份 - 账号隔离环境 - 每个配置文件使用虚拟 Gmail 账号 - 隐藏已安装应用列表 - 拟真的传感器数据：加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计和运动融合传感器均来自同一个模拟运动模型，而磁力计、气压计和光线传感器会跟随配置文件的位置、海拔和当地时间，使各传感器之间的交叉校验保持一致。 - 磁力计：模拟与配置文件位置和设备朝向一致的指南针磁场。 - 运动融合传感器：使重力、线性加速度、旋转矢量和方向与模拟运动保持一致。 - 气压计：报告与模拟位置海拔一致的气压，并带有缓慢的天气漂移。 - 传感器列表：让传感器列表及每个传感器的名称、厂商、量程和分辨率与模拟设备一致。 - 伪装设备运行时间 - 设备模拟 - 基于配置文件的系统 - 备份与恢复应用数据 - 按配置文件设置代理（每个配置文件可使用独立代理配置） - 隐藏可疑键盘 - 虚拟默认键盘值 - Официальный сайт: https://www.hidemyandroid.com Веб-приложение / Панель управления: https://app.hidemyandroid.com Инструкция по установке: https://www.hidemyandroid.com/ru/how-to-install/ ### Требования - Android 9.0+ (Pie или новее) - Android-устройство с root-доступом - Корректно работающая среда Xposed/LSPosed - Если вы не знакомы с модулями Xposed, этот проект может не подойти для вашей конфигурации. ### Как это работает Когда целевое приложение запрашивает идентификаторы или сигналы окружения, HideMyAndroid перехватывает запрос и возвращает заранее настроенные подменённые значения в зависимости от выбранного профиля. ### Список функций - Подмена идентификаторов устройства (Android ID, GAID, GSF ID, Widevine DRM ID, App Set ID, IMEI, серийный номер и др.) - Подмена данных SIM-карты - Подмена номера телефона - Скрытие Root - Скрытие LSPosed - Скрытие VPN-соединения - Скрытие активного прокси-соединения от приложений - Отпечаток браузера - Скрытие режима полёта - (Режим разработчика) - Подмена факта установки через Play Маркет - Подмена часового пояса по IP - Подмена региона по IP - Подмена GPS-координат по IP - Подмена идентичности приложения - Изолированная среда для аккаунтов - Виртуальные аккаунты Gmail для каждого профиля - Скрытие списка установленных приложений - Реалистичные данные сенсоров: акселерометр, гироскоп, магнитометр и датчики слияния движения используют одну имитируемую модель движения, а магнитометр, барометр и датчик освещённости следуют местоположению, высоте и местному времени профиля, поэтому перекрёстные проверки между датчиками остаются согласованными. - Магнитометр: имитирует магнитное поле компаса по местоположению профиля и ориентации устройства. - Датчики слияния движения: согласует гравитацию, линейное ускорение, вектор вращения и ориентацию с имитируемым движением. - Барометр: сообщает атмосферное давление, соответствующее высоте подменённого местоположения, с медленным погодным дрейфом. - Список датчиков: список датчиков и имя, производитель, диапазон и разрешение каждого датчика соответствуют имитируемому устройству. - Подмена времени работы устройства - Симуляция устройства - Система на основе профилей - Резервное копирование и восстановление данных приложений - Прокси для каждого профиля (каждый профиль может использовать собственную независимую конфигурацию прокси) - Скрытие
